items.title: An impurity over the henselization gives one over an elementary etale neighbourhood

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an impurity presented over the henselization of the base at the point already appears over an elementary etale neighbourhood (statement lines 4743-4750, tag 05J5-adjacent). The proof reduces to an affine neighbourhood, uses the description of the henselization as a filtered colimit of the rings of affine elementary etale neighbourhoods, and applies the descent statement for impurities along a filtered limit. The colimit description and its use are the substance, so the claim is H2.
